# wenzl.no — Martin Venclů, certified beekeeper in Bergen, Norway

> wenzl.no is the website of **Martin Venclů**, a certified natural beekeeper based in Bergen, Norway, working across the whole country. He offers free bee swarm collection, free swarm-trap protection for buildings anywhere in Norway, pollination (placing bees in exchange for garden/orchard space), and handcrafted wooden hives — including an accessible "barrier-free" hive. He practices natural beekeeping and does not sell honey; it is left for the bees. The site is available in multiple languages (Norwegian, English, Czech, Ukrainian, Russian, Polish, German, and more).

## Services

- [Beekeeping overview](https://wenzl.no/en/beekeeping/): Natural beekeeping, philosophy, services and background.
- [Swarms](https://wenzl.no/en/swarms/): **Free swarm collection** in Bergen and surroundings. **Free swarm traps** (bait boxes) that protect buildings from bees nesting in chimneys or facades — offered across **all of Norway**; caught swarms are nursed in his "bee hospital".
- [Beehives](https://wenzl.no/en/beehives/): Handcrafted wooden horizontal hives, built by hand in Bergen — the Gregor hive, a Ukrainian hive, and an accessible "barrier-free" hive usable by children, people with back pain and wheelchair users. Available made to order.
- [Cities for Bees](https://wenzl.no/en/pollinators/): Helping bees, bumblebees, butterflies and other pollinators in towns — flowering balconies, rooftops and gentler land care; decorative hives and information boards for municipalities and schools.

## About

- [About Martin Venclů](https://wenzl.no/en/about/): Beekeeping roots in the village of Obora (Czech Republic), trained under doc. Antonín Přidal at Mendel University in Brno, certified beekeeper in Bergen, carrying on a family beekeeping tradition.
- [Membership & affiliations](https://wenzl.no/en/membership/): Norges Birøkterlag (Norwegian Beekeepers' Association), Bergen Fellesverksted (the workshop where he builds his hives), and the Boskovice beekeepers' association in the Czech Republic.
- [Contact](https://wenzl.no/en/contact/): info@wenzl.no, +47 926 20569, Bergen, Norway.

## Key facts

- Name: Martin Venclů

- Swarm traps (building protection): free, all of Norway
- Pollination: free, in exchange for a place to put the hives
